_comment: Golden fixture for the deterministic layer. Every case is copied from the LIVE feed on 2026-09-08, not invented. A fixture whose expectations its own author computed cannot prove the specification was right - these are transcriptions of real records, which is the closest this domain gets to an external oracle.
